links.outcome: GPT-4 warfarin dose recommendations compared with physician dosing and modeled INR normalization
links.effect: Doses within ±1 mg/week of physician in 74% and ±2 mg/week in 84%; mean 27.5 vs 28.0 mg/week (p=.12); modeled therapeutic INR 69% vs 72% (p=.15).
links.quote: Seventy-two percent of patients achieved therapeutic INR under physician-managed dosing, while the model suggested a 69% success rate for ChatGPT-guided dosing (p = .15).

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT's ability to recommend warfarin dose adjustments using retrospective patient data compared to physician dosing and modeled outcomes, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
